info.name: Smithsonian Open Access content search API

params.name: q
params.description: The query string. Accepts boolean operators (AND, OR) and fielded searches (e.g. topic:Gastropoda). See /terms endpoints for valid field types.

params.name: start
params.description: The starting row offset for pagination.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order of the result set. Default is relevancy. newest sorts by timestamp descending. updated sorts by lastTimeUpdated descending.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of row object. Each type conforms to a published schema.

params.name: row_group
params.description: The designated set of row types to filter against. Objects refers to objects, artifacts, and specimens. Archives are all archives collection and item records.

items.docs: Fetches content based on a query across all Smithsonian collections.
